sections.extract: The volume of a hyperbolic knot $K\subset S^3$ has a natural perturbative deformation constructed from the quantum dilogarithm~\cite{Hikami:stateint}. sections.title: Proving Borel–Laplace summability
sections.extract: \label{sec:BL-intro} Starting with a Gevrey-1 formal power series, the process of resurgence requires convergence and then analytic continuation of the series's Borel transform~\cite{EcalleI,diverg-resurg-i}. Recall that the Borel transform $\calB$ is defined as the formal inverse of the Laplace transform \be\label{eq:laplace} \calL^\vartheta(\phi):=\int_0^{e^{i\vartheta}\infty} e^{-\z/\hbar} \phi(\z) \, d\z\,, \ee
